title: FM-01: Heap Allocation on Audio Thread
summary: Critical failure mode: heap allocations cause audio dropouts and crashes.
description:
## Symptom

Audio dropouts, glitches, occasional crashes. CPU spikes visible in profiler.

## Cause

Heap allocation on audio thread via:
- `new` / `delete`
- `std::vector::push_back()`
- `std::string` construction
- `juce::String` construction
- `DBG()` macro
- Any container that may reallocate

## Fix

Pre-allocate all buffers in `prepareToPlay()`:

```cpp
void prepareToPlay(double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock) override {
    buffer.setSize(2, samplesPerBlock);  // Pre-allocate
    delayBuffer.setSize(2, static_cast<int>(sampleRate * 2.0));  // Max 2 seconds
}
```

## Prevention

- Code review checklist: search for allocations in processBlock
- Use `juce::ScopedNoDenormals` as reminder anchor
- Run pluginval strictness 5+
- Profile with Perfetto to detect allocation stalls

## Detection

- pluginval strictness 5+: catches allocations
- Perfetto profiling: shows allocation stalls
- Manual code audit: grep for `new`, `delete`, `push_back`, `String`
